decisions.reason: The dietary supplement range is a core part of the firm's growing pharmacy consumer health portfolio and costs little to maintain.
The skin and hair supplement serves a steady pharmacy beauty-from-within segment within an established brand line, so keeping it is cheap.
Joint health is a large and stable segment for an ageing population and strengthens the Trivital brand.
The mushroom-based immune supplement is a niche product, but post-pandemic interest in immunity makes it worth keeping for now.
Despite the 2018 recall and price pressure, valsartan is a high-volume generic that fits the broad generics range once clean active ingredient supply is secured.
The OTC migraine triptan is a differentiated pharmacy product with good margins that supports the consumer health expansion strategy.
